# Fixed signature fixture (wasm-signed)

`crates/lattice-plugins/src/wasm/tests.rs::real_ed25519_signed_package_registers_as_trusted_and_invokable`
uses the fixtures in this directory to verify a **real Ed25519 signature** (not a mock):

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `plugin.wasm` | `(module (memory ...) (alloc ...) (process ...))` passthrough plugin, generated by `wasm-plugin-fixture wasm echo` (WAT→wasm) |
| `manifest.json` | `ns=signed-echo` + `signature` (base64) + `signing_key_id=lattice-e2e-fixture-1` |
| `fixture.json` | verification public key (base64 raw 32B), canonical manifest JSON, digest to sign in hex |

Signature format (design ② §4.5):

```text
payload   = sha256( wasm_bytes || canonical_manifest_json )   // 32 bytes
signature = Ed25519_sign(private_key, payload)                // 64 bytes, stored base64 in manifest.signature
canonical_manifest_json = {"ns":..,"version":..,"entry":..,"deps":[..],"limits":{"memory_mb":..,"fuel":..,"timeout_ms":..}}
```

## Regenerating

```text
# 1) Generate the wasm
scripts\cargo.cmd run -q -p lattice-plugins --example wasm-plugin-fixture -- wasm echo plugin.wasm
# 2) Write manifest.base.json without the signature (fields identical to fixture.json.canonical_manifest_json)
# 3) Get the canonical JSON and the digest to sign
scripts\cargo.cmd run -q -p lattice-plugins --example wasm-plugin-fixture -- canonical-json manifest.base.json
scripts\cargo.cmd run -q -p lattice-plugins --example wasm-plugin-fixture -- payload-hash plugin.wasm manifest.base.json
# 4) Node crypto derives the Ed25519 private key from a fixed seed and signs (see scripts/wasm-plugin-e2e.mjs --emit-fixture's
#    GENERATION_SEED = sha256("lattice-wasm-plugin-e2e-fixture-v1")), then write back manifest.json/fixture.json
```

The fixed seed exists only to make the fixture reproducible: **the private key exists only as a derivation from the fixed seed in the generation script**, it is not a production key,
and `trusted_keys` registers only this fixture's public key. Real release keys are kept offline by the publisher and never stored in the repo.
